title: Flow-ERD: Agent-type Aware Flow Matching With Entropy-Regularized Distillation for Diverse Traffic Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2607.06957v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Realistic and diverse traffic simulation is essential to autonomous driving development. Yet prevailing benchmarks predominantly reward realism, and recent methods have optimized accordingly, leaving diversity underexplored. We introduce Flow-ERD, a multi-agent simulator that pursues realism and diversity jointly. Its backbone, Agent-Type Aware Flow Matching (AFM), couples flow matching's multi-modal expressiveness with type-specific kinematic execution. It preserves fine-grained diversity while keeping motions consistent with each agent type. A second stage, Entropy-Regularized Distillation (ERD), fine-tunes the closed-loop rollout distribution with an entropy-regularized reverse-KL objective. This mitigates closed-loop covariate shift while explicitly preventing collapse onto high-density modes. We evaluate Flow-ERD with Cross-Pair Diversity and its validity-gated variant alongside standard realism scores. Validation experime

translated_title: Flow-ERD：面向多样化交通仿真的智能体类型感知流匹配与熵正则化蒸馏
translated_abstract: 真实且多样化的交通仿真对自动驾驶的开发至关重要。然而，现有主流基准主要奖励真实性，近期方法也据此进行优化，导致多样性方面未被充分探索。我们提出Flow-ERD，一个同时追求真实性与多样性的多智能体仿真器。其核心骨干是智能体类型感知流匹配（AFM），它将流匹配的多模态表达能力与特定类型的运动学执行相结合，在保留细粒度多样性的同时，使运动与各智能体类型保持一致。第二阶段为熵正则化蒸馏（ERD），采用熵正则化的反向KL目标对闭环推演分布进行微调，在缓解闭环协变量偏移的同时，显式防止模型坍缩到高密度模态上。我们使用交叉对多样性（Cross-Pair Diversity）及其有效性门控变体以及标准的真实性评分来评估Flow-ERD。验证实验……
tldr: Flow-ERD通过智能体类型感知流匹配与熵正则化蒸馏两阶段框架，在多智能体交通仿真中联合优化真实性与多样性，并有效防止闭环推演中的模式坍缩问题。
en_tdlr: Flow-ERD jointly pursues realism and diversity in multi-agent traffic simulation via agent-type aware flow matching and entropy-regularized distillation, mitigating covariate shift while preventing collapse onto high-density modes during closed-loop rollouts.
